label: T3
notes: T3 transplants quantum reservoir computing (seen once in pricing in the P3 corpus) to streaming fraud detection. Bare = a single feature-injection block applied to the reservoir (the depth a reservoir-computing paper typically reports). Full = the full streaming rollout: T reservoir Hamiltonian-evolution timesteps, each preceded by feature injection, which is the per-sample computational cost actually incurred during classification. The reservoir Hamiltonian is a fixed random transverse-field Ising Hamiltonian on a linear chain.
